name: UpdateFile
description: Renames or updates a file in SharePoint using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the SharePoint request.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The path of the file in SharePoint that you want to update. For example: /sites/YourSite/Shared Documents/YourFile.txt

fields.name: FileName
fields.label: New File Name
fields.description: The new name for the file. If left blank, the file will not be renamed.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the file update operation, including success status and any error messages.
